gloss: agreement; written agreement; memorandum of understanding

definitions.gloss: written agreement; memorandum of understanding; accord document
definitions.explanation: A formal written document recording the terms agreed upon by two or more parties. Less binding than a full contract but carries legal and moral weight.

examples.japanese: {合意書|ごういしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{署名|しょめい}する→署名する：22432_shomeisuru⟧。
⟦{両者|りょうしゃ}→両者：11357_ryousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{合意書|ごういしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わした→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧。
examples.english: Both parties exchanged a written agreement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{合意書|ごういしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}→作成：04186_sakusei⟧し、⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: We drafted an agreement on the divorce conditions and had a lawyer review it.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{合意|ごうい}→合意：05093_goui⟧ (agreement/consensus) + ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (document). Used in legal, business, and personal contexts where parties need to formally record their agreement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合意書|ごういしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧: to draft an agreement
- {合意書|ごういしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{署名|しょめい}する→署名する：22432_shomeisuru⟧: to sign an agreement
- {合意書|ごういしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧: to exchange agreements
- {合意書|ごういしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧: contents of the agreement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧: contract — a more formal and legally binding document
- ⟦{覚書|おぼえがき}→覚書：07963_oboegaki⟧: memorandum — a written record of understanding, similar in function
- ⟦{同意書|どういしょ}→同意書：06449_douisho⟧: consent form — a document expressing consent to something specific
- ⟦{誓約書|せいやくしょ}→誓約書：08013_seiyakusho⟧: written pledge — a document with a promise or oath
